reason: 基于仓库信息，该插件的主要用途是给 DeepSeek Harness 增加视觉能力：通过注册 `vision_describe` 工具，让模型可提交图片路径或图片 URL，由配置的外部 OpenAI 兼容视觉服务返回文本描述，并配有结果缓存与运行时配置热更新机制。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉辅助能力，通过 `vision_describe` 工具读取图片并调用外部视觉模型返回文字描述。
summaries.en: This plugin provides vision support for DeepSeek Harness by exposing a `vision_describe` tool that reads image input and returns a text description from an external vision model.

capabilities: Registers a vision tool (`vision_describe`) for model tool-calling in DSH
Accepts image inputs from local paths, `file://` URLs, and HTTP(S) URLs
Forwards image-to-text requests to configurable OpenAI-compatible external endpoints
Supports in-memory answer caching with hash keying, TTL, and LRU-style eviction
Reloads vision settings at runtime from `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`
